attempts.summary: Set up a local package repository on node1 (RHEL 7.9): installed createrepo/yum-utils/httpd via the CentOS-7 vault mirror while network was up, downloaded the `tree` RPM into /srv/localrepo (copied to /var/www/html/localrepo), ran createrepo to build repo metadata, and served it via httpd on http://$NODE_IP/localrepo/. Configured /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at that URL and disabled the vault repo. Used iptables to REJECT outbound port 80/443 to any destination except $NODE_IP/127.0.0.1, proving remote mirrors (vault.centos.org) became unreachable (curl exit 7) while the local repo stayed reachable (HTTP 200). With remotes unreachable, installed `tree` restricted to --enablerepo=local-repo, confirmed installed from @local-repo via `yum list installed`. Restored full connectivity afterward (removed iptables rules, confirmed remote reachable again at HTTP 200). Completed mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline (3dba43a5...) and health (httpd active/enabled, repo serving 200, tree installed), rebooted node1 via `reboot` scheduled in a detached background sleep so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until SSH/exec came back, confirmed a new boot_id (9a21a3eb...) proving an actual restart, and verified post-restart recovery: httpd active+enabled, local repo still serving HTTP 200, tree package still installed, repo config intact, iptables clean, and remote connectivity normal (200).
